stories.title: Why I build
stories.summary: I want useful ideas to have the resources and opportunity to make a difference.
stories.body: I want to build an R&D organization capable of supporting ambitious products, scientific research, and public-interest systems. I'm learning how to build that organization, one experiment at a time.

stories.title: Learning in public
stories.summary: Products, research, engineering, creative technology — one experiment at a time.
stories.body: I enjoy composing music, building games, playing sports, learning new things, and documenting the process.

stories.title: Beyond engineering
stories.summary: A late-starting sportswoman who loves the journey as much as the competition.
stories.body: I want to keep growing through sports, camaraderie, friendships, and competitive experiences.

stories.title: A world worth building
stories.summary: More autonomy, health, education, security, dignity, and connection.
stories.body: My hope is that powerful technology can help reduce unnecessary suffering while expanding human freedom, health, safety, and opportunity.

stories.title: Enjoy the journey
stories.summary: Trust the process. Find friends and build meaningful things together.
stories.body: I live for the camaraderie and passion that come alive when people strive together for something they truly care about.
